summary: Following the verification finding one step further turned up a second source inside the same count, and I recorded it as an extension of the same cause rather than as a new one. verifyLeader credits the leader with a vote unconditionally before it consults any configuration, and only then sets the target to the voter quorum and registers the verification on every replication state; so the count draws on sources that may hold no vote in two ways: the acknowledgements of non-voting members, which I recorded last turn, and the leader's own self-credit, which is granted even when the latest configuration no longer gives the local node a vote, the window a leader occupies after appending its own removal or demotion and before that entry commits. I extended the saved behaviour on its existing id with a changed premise that says plainly what moved - the narrower statement named one source and reading shows a second of the same kind - and recorded the same extension on the investigation so the question covers both sources, with the contrast and countermeasure kept in view: elections are unaffected because electSelf asks voters only, and the leader-lease check counts voters only and so bounds the false positive. I spent no execution on it because it is a reading-derived extension, and I chose it over another closing hand-off after the controller pointed out that the unchanged submission had already been retained. The measured and witnessed parts of the record are unchanged: the six behaviours witnessed with receipts, including the durable term regression twice reproduced with its causal control and bounded by two uninstrumented probes, the protocol-gate bypass on the heartbeat fast path, the scoped log-cache negative, and the two knowledge corrections, plus the one open question about asymmetric write latencies as the next step.
